beforeAgentCallbacks.description: Sets the flag "enable_fallback_and_reclassification" to disable reclassification only for lightweight steering agent.

afterAgentCallbacks.description: [10-step Limit Handling] Reset LLM steps to 0 at the end of the turn.

beforeModelCallbacks.description: [10-step Limit Handling] Count the LLM steps and prevent the conversation from failing due to reaching 10-step limit by returning a fallback response at 10th step.
If next_agent_actions is set, play the specified agent response or perform the specified actions (agent transfer, end session, tool calls).

Hide tools that are not mentioned in the current instruction.
